name: Testable Cloud Starter
free_limit: Hosted Performance & API Testing Starter includes 100 virtual-user-hours per month, up to 50 concurrent virtual users, 2-hour maximum test duration, unlimited tests and team members, and 3 months of data retention. A separate hosted Functional Testing Starter offers 75 minutes per month of live and automated browser testing.
watch_out: Free monthly quotas apply separately to the provider's testing products. Selenium virtual users are billed at 10x and Puppeteer/Playwright at 5x virtual-user equivalents. Paid pay-as-you-go and self-managed testing plans are distinct; card requirement and commercial-use terms for the free Starter are not explicitly confirmed on the pricing page and need human verification.
